**Campanile 0.1: a neighborhood information and help point that keeps working when the internet is gone.**

A laptop or a Raspberry Pi becomes a local Wi-Fi network. Anyone nearby connects with their own
phone, no app and no account, and finds official notices, an "I need / I can help" board, an
"I'm safe" registry, an offline map and offline medical articles from Wikipedia.

**What's inside**

- **An offline map of the world, and your area street by street.** Search a street, a town or a
  shop, or tap **Hospital, Pharmacy, Water, Police** to see the nearest.
- **A navigator, without internet**, on foot or by car. Whoever runs the Campanile can mark a
  flooded or collapsed street: every route then avoids it, and it shows in red on everyone's map.
- **Wikipedia's medical articles in Italian, English or both**, readable offline.
- **Official alerts.** Notices signed by an authority's key (Ed25519), and alerts in CAP, the
  format of Italy's IT-alert. "I'm safe" names can be handed over in PFIF, Person Finder's format.
- **More than one volunteer.** Each gets a password of their own, and the log says who did what.
- **More Campaniles without internet.** Copy a Campanile to a USB stick and it starts on another
  computer with nothing installed. Maps and Wikipedia also travel over Wi-Fi between Campaniles.
- **Signed versions.** Every version is signed by CarrotStudio with a key kept offline. A
  Campanile updates from a USB stick only to a newer signed version, checked where it will run,
  and a power cut halfway through is finished at the next start.
- **Security reviews.** Our own, done as attackers: every flaw found is fixed and covered by a
  test that fails on the old code. There has been no external audit yet.

**Check this package yourself**, with a copy you already trust, such as a clone of this repository
(not the package's own checker, which could lie about itself): `python3 campanile/release.py
path/to/campanile-0.1.0` says whether every program file is the one CarrotStudio signed.
`SHA256SUMS` and the build provenance (`gh attestation verify campanile-0.1.0.zip -R
Carrotstudiosoftwarehouse/campanile`) are here too.

**Download:** `campanile-0.1.0.zip` below. Unzip it, then double-click *Avvia Campanile (Windows)*
or *Avvia Campanile (Mac)*. The first time, a setup page downloads the map and the medical
articles. For a Raspberry Pi: [docs/SETUP.md](https://github.com/Carrotstudiosoftwarehouse/campanile/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md#raspberry-pi).

**Experimental.** Tested on macOS, Windows and Linux, in one field test with no internet at all,
and with up to 1,000 simulated phones. **Not yet tried for real:** a Raspberry Pi, Android phones
as guests, many real phones at once, non-technical families. Our limits, honestly:
[docs/LIMITS.md](https://github.com/Carrotstudiosoftwarehouse/campanile/blob/main/docs/LIMITS.md).
If you can test those parts, please tell us how it went.

---

**Campanile 0.1: un punto di informazione e aiuto di quartiere che funziona anche senza internet.**
Bacheca, avvisi ufficiali (anche firmati e in CAP, il formato di IT-alert), "sto bene", mappa del
mondo e della tua zona, un navigatore che evita le strade interrotte, Wikipedia medica, tutto senza
internet. Ogni versione è firmata da CarrotStudio, e un Campanile si aggiorna da chiavetta solo a
una versione firmata. Scarica `campanile-0.1.0.zip`, scompatta e fai doppio clic su *Avvia
Campanile (Windows)* o *(Mac)*. È una versione sperimentale: i nostri limiti, detti onestamente,
sono in [docs/LIMITI.md](https://github.com/Carrotstudiosoftwarehouse/campanile/blob/main/docs/LIMITI.md).
